about.subtitle: Who We Are
about.desc_1: With over 20 years of experience supporting government institutions, private companies, and educational organizations, we understand that each organization has its own unique challenges, culture, and needs. Therefore, we are committed to delivering practical and relevant solutions, ranging from organizational development consulting and learning program design to the implementation of talent management strategies.
about.desc_2: PT. Cakrawala Parama Internasional (CPI) is a reliable partner in advancing organizational growth and talent development, backed by specialists with over 20 years of experience in government, private sectors, and academic institutions.
about.feature_2_desc: Leveraging the latest in AI to automate your workflow.
about.vision_desc: To become an Indonesian company with a global reach in the fields of human capital and organizational development, information technology, and event management.
about.mission_1: Establish partnerships both domestically and internationally to provide broader insights into human capital and organizational development.
about.mission_2: Drive innovation in the execution of events, both locally and globally.
about.mission_3: Conduct international benchmarking to enhance and develop the services offered.
about.mission_4: Develop appropriate information technology solutions aligned with the needs and capabilities of human capital and organizations.
about.mission_5: Deliver comprehensive services in the fields of human resource and organizational development, education, and gender equality.
about.mission_6: Contribute to human development and support equitable access to education in Indonesia.
about.mission_7: Continuously innovate to provide the highest quality of service.
